Brian Burgess 
+1 202 346 4215 
BBurgess@goodwinlaw.com 

Goodwin Procter LLP 
901 New York Avenue NW 
Washington, DC 20001 

goodwinlaw.com 
+1 202 346 4000 

November 5, 2019 

BY HAND 

Hon. Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Arthur J. Lomax v. Christina Ortiz-Marquez et al., No. 18-8369 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I am counsel of record for petitioner in the above-captioned case.  After consulting with counsel for 
respondents, I respectfully request pursuant to Rules 25.5 and 30.4 that the Court extend the deadlines 
for the parties’ principal briefs as follows: 

          Petitioner’s brief:  Monday, December 9, 2019 
          Respondents’ brief:  Wednesday, January 15, 2020 

Counsel for respondents agrees to this proposed schedule.  

Thank you very much for your assistance. 

Respectfully Yours, 

Brian Burgess 

cc (by e-mail):  

Eric Olson, Esq., counsel of record for respondents
